llm.summary: This Mailchimp skill is mostly coherent and read-only, but it handles OAuth credentials while allowing an unvalidated API base and unpinned runtime tooling.

dimensions.detail: Mailchimp network access and an OAuth token are proportionate to the purpose, but the configurable destination is broader than Mailchimp-only access and could expose the bearer token if misconfigured or redirected.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The install path can install an unpinned global mcporter package, and the Python script declares open-ended mcp and certifi dependencies resolved by uv at runtime.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill discloses token-based Mailchimp access, but the runtime accepts MAVERICK_MAILCHIMP_MCP_API_BASE without validating that it is an HTTPS Mailchimp API host before sending the bearer token.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No system persistence, background service, file indexing, destructive action, or local privilege escalation was found, but a globally installed CLI has broader host impact than a project-local pinned executable.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to search and read Mailchimp audiences, members, campaigns, content, and reports, and the inspected Python MCP tools are GET-only and match that read-oriented purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you trust the environment that provisions the Mailchimp token and API base. Prefer a version that pins mcporter and Python dependencies, validates the API base to Mailchimp HTTPS hosts, and runs with only the two required environment variables and limited outbound network access.
llm.findings:
[PE3] expected: References to the Mailchimp access token are expected for an OAuth-backed Mailchimp MCP wrapper and are disclosed as environment variables, not hidden credential-file harvesting.
[LP3] unexpected: The concern is partly supported because the artifacts do not constrain network destinations or tool scope beyond documentation, despite handling a bearer token.
[SDI-1] unexpected: The agent metadata uses broader wording such as managing campaigns and automations, while the actual SKILL.md and server.py describe and expose read-only tools.
[SQP-2] expected: Outbound Mailchimp API requests with query parameters are expected and disclosed in the data-flow section; the remaining issue is destination scoping rather than hidden transmission.
[T09] unexpected: The static finding is supported in substance: the server sends Authorization bearer tokens to whatever API base is configured and does not validate scheme, host, port, path, or redirect behavior.
[T08] unexpected: The static supply-chain concern is supported: mcporter is unpinned and globally installed if missing, and Python dependencies use lower-bound version constraints rather than exact reviewed versions.
